{"id": 101, "body": "Root cause: auth/auth.go parseBearer (line 63) checks HasPrefix(h, \"Bearer\") with no space, then does strings.SplitN(h, \" \", 2)[1]. A header of exactly \"Bearer\" gives a one-element slice, so indexing [1] panics (cr_f9ee9e, 3 times, from an okhttp client). Fix: check for the prefix \"Bearer \" with the space, or check len(parts) == 2 before indexing. A reproducer test would be auth/bearer_test.go, with inputs \"Bearer\", \"Bearer \", \"Bearerx tok1\" expecting ok=false. I could not apply it: writes under auth/ are blocked by a protection rule, so this still needs a person with access to auth/."}
